comment: Infrastructure-trail hoop route (the /infrastructure page), in world units after Mountain3D's sinkY (-3) transform. Points tagged with `hoop` are the visible marker hoops (y = ground + 0.8, so the flat ring sits on the rock); the rest are via points that shape the orb's path so it hugs the terrain. Spirals counter-clockwise seen from above: front base -> east wall -> back face -> west shoulder -> summit. Validate with `npm run test:orb` after editing.
